hints: The question is about the *end* of the stream, and the end is the part that keeps changing. What would be easier to match if the stream were read backwards?
A suffix read backwards is a prefix - so store the words reversed in a trie, and walk the stream backwards from the newest letter.
Then each call walks back at most as far as the longest word, following the reversed trie and checking for an end-of-word marker as it goes.
Keep the letters seen so far in a list, and only the last few are ever needed - anything older than the longest word can never be part of a match.
